shared_elements: rounded-topped upright slab/monolith bearing carving on its broad face
schematic mask-like or anthropomorphic face elements
carving arranged vertically over the whole field
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, broad-lined curvilinear relief with schematic mask-like features and a prominent circular/concentric disc set into the composition on a tall rounded-topped field, which gives a general stylistic kinship. But A depicts a single sculpted body with a distinct head, headdress, shoulders, arms and a chest medallion above banded lower garment, whereas B is a flat panel filled edge-to-edge with interlocking abstract scroll and glyph-like units with no coherent single body, so the specific subject and relationships differ substantially.
